title: AI_ORCHESTRA Usage
description: Model runtime usage and budget observability for a task run.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this usage data belongs to.

worker_calls.description: Number of worker agent invocations made during the run.

reviewer_calls.description: Number of reviewer agent invocations made during the run.

correction_rounds.description: Number of correction rounds executed during the run.

runtime_seconds.description: Total execution time of the run in seconds.

total_tokens.description: Total observed token consumption. May be zero if token usage is unavailable.

by_agent.description: Optional breakdown of token and call consumption per agent.

calls.description: Number of times this specific agent was invoked.

runtime_seconds.description: Total runtime in seconds for this agent.

total_tokens.description: Total token consumption for this agent, if available. May be zero.

prompt_tokens.description: Input/prompt token consumption for this agent, if available. May be zero.

completion_tokens.description: Output/completion token consumption for this agent, if available. May be zero.
